title: ...walk into a new hotel room
desc: Ensure your room is secure, sanitary, and functional before unpacking.
todos: Inspect mattress seams, headboard corners, and sheets for bedbug signs.
Verify main door deadbolt, secondary latch, and peep-hole function properly.
Locate emergency fire exit stairwells relative to your floor room location.
Sanitize high-touch items like TV remote, door handles, and light switches.
Test air conditioning, hot water, and electronic room safe lock operation.
